+"""Record and verify the fixed pick_dual_bottles scene."""
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from rcb_traj import Session
+from envs.utils import ArmTag
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+
+def report(s, label):
+    e = s.env
+    print(label, json.dumps({
+        'status': s.status(),
+        'plan_success': bool(e.plan_success),
+        'bottle1': e.bottle1.get_functional_point(0).tolist(),
+        'bottle2': e.bottle2.get_functional_point(0).tolist(),
+        'left_ee': list(e.robot.get_left_ee_pose()),
+        'right_ee': list(e.robot.get_right_ee_pose()),
+    }), flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    s = Session('pick_dual_bottles', instance='/app/instance.json')
+    e = s.env
+    left, right = ArmTag('left'), ArmTag('right')
+    report(s, 'initial')
+    s.record_start()
+    e.move(e.grasp_actor(e.bottle1, left, pre_grasp_dis=0.1, grasp_dis=0),
+           e.grasp_actor(e.bottle2, right, pre_grasp_dis=0.1, grasp_dis=0))
+    report(s, 'grasped')
+    e.move(e.move_by_displacement(left, z=0.16),

+    report(s, 'lifted')
+    e.move(e.place_actor(e.bottle1, left, e.left_target_pose,
+                         functional_point_id=0, pre_dis=0, dis=0,
+                         is_open=False, constrain='free'),
+           e.place_actor(e.bottle2, right, e.right_target_pose,
+                         functional_point_id=0, pre_dis=0, dis=0,
+                         is_open=False, constrain='free'))
+    for _ in range(250):
+        s.step()
+    report(s, 'final')
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    if not s.status()['success']:
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'attempt.npz')
+        raise RuntimeError('Recorded attempt did not succeed')
+    replay_status = s.replay(actions)
+    report(s, 'replay')
+    if not replay_status['success']:
+        raise RuntimeError('Open-loop replay did not succeed')
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz')
+    print('saved', actions.shape, flush=True)
+
+

    constrain: Literal["free", "align"] = "free",

    z_transform: bool = True,
